## GHL Lead Automation v2
Production URL: `https://blueviolet-parrot-909837.hostingersite.com/webhook/ghl-lead-v2`

**Before activating** (see `SETUP-v2.md`):
1. Run **GHL v2 - Setup Sheets** once (creates `Leads_v2` + `Rejected`).
2. Google Sheets nodes: service-account credential + replace `__SHEET_ID__`.
3. GHL HTTP nodes: Header Auth credential `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
4. Telegram node: credential + replace `__TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID__`.
5. Settings → Error workflow → **GHL v2 - Error Alert**.

Scoring rules live in the `CONFIG` object at the top of **Score Lead**.
